hotspots.label: Old lakeside mansion
hotspots.message: The door is boarded shut. A faded notice asks visitors to leave the house undisturbed until its missing records are recovered. A light flickers in the attic.

hotspots.label: Orchard Playground
hotspots.message: The neighbors built this playground from reclaimed ferry timber. The wide gate is always open.

hotspots.label: Orchard Lake
hotspots.message: Small fish flicker among the reeds. River Tackle can guide you to the working fishing dock; lake catches will come later.

hotspots.label: The old dock mark
hotspots.message: The broken-circle hammer mark was carved before the flood. The builders still use it when they set the first stone of a new home.

hotspots.label: Lantern Hill overlook
hotspots.message: This hill sheltered the ferry families during the flood. The lantern path still leads their children home.

hotspots.label: An orchard letter
hotspots.message: We planted the trees when the river took our first garden. If you are beginning again, take an apple and stay awhile.

hotspots.label: The square inscription
hotspots.message: One stone, one welcome. Each household brought a stone to rebuild this square after the flood. There is still room for yours.

hotspots.label: A future address
hotspots.message: The builders have marked the ground for a new home. This address is not available for purchase yet.

npcs.name: Mira
npcs.label: Talk to Mira
chatter: Have you seen the lake this morning?
npcs.message: Mara says a town begins with a warm table. I say it begins with someone carrying the bread. Meet Toma at the Pet Center and our Dockmaster, then choose a home. We have room for another neighbor.

npcs.name: Toma
npcs.label: Talk to Toma
chatter: The park gate is always open.
npcs.message: That puppy keeps popping up to greet everyone, and the cat pretends she is not watching. Your own companion is welcome too. A home and a little care can make even a restless creature feel safe.

npcs.name: Dockmaster
npcs.label: Talk to Dockmaster
chatter: The river is running clear today.
npcs.message: The new fishing outfitter is open, and the path to Shadow Woods is clear. Bring your catches home. See that hammer mark by the quay? The old builders left us more than sturdy stone.

npcs.name: Innkeeper
npcs.label: Talk to Innkeeper
chatter: The lanterns will be lit by supper.
npcs.message: The kettle is always on at Lantern Inn. Travelers bring stories from beyond the ridge, and we give them somewhere warm to share them. The lobby is open; overnight room booking will come later.

npcs.name: Rowan the builder
npcs.label: Talk to Rowan the builder
chatter: A sturdy home for the next family.
npcs.message: The river brings new faces every season. We are making room for the next family.
